text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the request of Lucky Lilac, who has 
been feeling a bit out of sorts lately, I 
visited the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, shall we? We must sever this 
chain of misfortune right here—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready, Lala? Even if it's just 
training, I'm going all out!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're on! —Wait.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rip rip rip!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? How can my shoelaces all be 
snapped like this?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
""Aaaah! Sold out here too! How many 
stores has it been already?!""

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No good, I can't buy the shoes and 
sportswear I was lookin' for at all...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention gettin' caught in a 
downpour during my run... it was a total 
mess. At this point, I've gotta be cursed 
or somethin'—
choice_data_list:
...That must have been really tough on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, all that ends today. Let's make 
sure to pray properly to the gods and 
boost our luck.
choice_data_list:
It's a little surprising to see you 
praying to the gods.

It's a little surprising to see you 
praying to the gods.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'll pray to the gods and all that. I 
actually kinda like fortune-telling too, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Riding the emotional rollercoaster of TV 
horoscopes is pretty fun in its own way."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"—Though, my level of seriousness today is 
on a whole 'nother level."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I've studied the etiquette here, cleansed 
myself with a cold shower, and even 
prepared freshly dry-cleaned clothes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My parents strictly taught me that 
"When praying to God, you have to stand up 
straight and proper."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, ya gotta take care of the things ya 
can handle on your own."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how tough it gets, seeing it 
through yourself is the true spirit of a 
star, I reckon.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I believe there are some things in 
this world that are simply beyond the 
power of an ordinary Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, it's fine to rely on 
something greater. In return, though, you 
gotta approach it with the right mindset.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as being too polite. 
If we're the ones asking for a favor, we 
need to show the proper respect.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't dislike it. Straightening 
yourself up like this to pay your respects 
to the gods.
choice_data_list:
Got it. I'll make the request seriously 
too.

Got it. I'm counting on you too, and I 
mean it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll be countin' on ya. Right then, shall 
we get goin'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(God, I won't ask for much. Anything I can 
do myself, I plan to do all by myself.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Could you just ward off any unnecessary 
misfortunes so that I can give my absolute 
best effort?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I humbly ask for your kind support!
choice_data_list: I hope my wish comes true.
I hope your wish comes true.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Only the heavens know the answer to that, 
but... ...yeah, I've done everything I 
could."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow, that really cleared my head. 
Let's just believe our feelings got 
through to her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps her earnest attitude paid off. 
Lucky Lilac's streak of bad luck came to 
an end, and she quickly returned to top 
form.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Please, God. Keep unnecessary bad luck 
away from me.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...While we're at it, maybe I can recoup 
some of the losses we took?)

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw! Caw, caw!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a crow's coming right at us! 
Trainer, hurry and run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because her shrine visit was cut 
short, Lucky Lilac's streak of bad luck 
continued for a while longer.
